title: Kitfo Stew with Beef
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish made with sautéed beef, onions, and spices, served with a kick of heat.

ingredients.name: Ethiopian spices (mitmita or berbere)
ingredients.notes: Available at most African or Middle Eastern grocery stores

instructions: Heat the kicked butter in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the mitmita or berbere spices, peppercorns, and garlic. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the corned beef and chopped beef. Cook for 2 minutes.
Simmer the stew for 20-25 minutes, or until the meat is tender.
Serve hot over injera or with rice.
Optional: garnish with chopped cilantro or parsley.
